purpose: Test whether a single official-teacher cost evaluation at CEM round 30 captures the benefit previously observed from seven late teacher rounds, without training or changing the student checkpoint.

teacher.loader: Existing validated load_official_checkpoint(cache_root); used only on round 30

task_and_protocol.preprocessing: Reuse the exact successful baseline full-dataset action/proprio/state StandardScaler fits, NaN-row exclusions, goal-scaler reuse, and ImageNet/Resize224 pixel and goal transforms.
task_and_protocol.world_evaluator: Pinned World.evaluate dataset mode and baseline callables; goal_offset_steps=25, eval_budget=50, world.max_episode_steps=100, video=None.
task_and_protocol.evaluator_boundary: Upstream-protocol-aligned dataset evaluation, not verbatim upstream eval.py and not random-reset PushT.
task_and_protocol.solver: Pinned CEMSolver; batch_size=1, num_samples=300, n_steps=30, topk=30, var_scale=1, CUDA, native torch.Generator seed 42, no per-call reseeding.
task_and_protocol.observation_pairing: Reuse exact source rows and deterministic baseline preprocessing/evaluator. Require dataset row identity and all six prepared observation keys, and record their shapes/dtypes. Historical runs retained key/equality checks but not raw prepared tensors, so do not claim a new bytewise cross-job tensor comparison.

reference_outcomes_sources.student_only: 25536308.pbs101 treatment_step1000 arm; its 50 per-task outcomes were verified identical to 25536049.pbs101 student_only.
reference_outcomes_sources.late_teacher7: 25536049.pbs101 late_teacher7 arm, 25/50, from the same task rows and evaluator; a separate valid run 25535873.pbs101 recorded 26/50, so the 25/50 vector is one descriptive reference, not a stable repeated outcome.

arm.name: final_only_round30
arm.rule: At each actual pinned CEMSolver start_batch, use student cost for rounds 1-29 and official teacher cost only for round 30.

primary_comparison.unit: Paired task/source episode; the exact 50 frozen source episodes each occur once.
primary_comparison.test: Exact two-sided McNemar test using frozen per-task student outcomes.

decision_rules.final_only_practical_gain: At least 5 more successes than student_only and exact p<0.05.
decision_rules.final_only_sufficient_for_late_gain: Primary practical-gain gate passes and final_only_round30 reaches at least 20/50, within five successes of the one-time 25/50 late_teacher7 reference from 25536049.pbs101. Another valid late7 run was 26/50; this engineering gate is not statistical equivalence or a claim that late7 is stable.
decision_rules.final_only_gain_but_below_late_margin: Primary practical-gain gate passes but final_only_round30 is more than 5 successes below late_teacher7.
decision_rules.no_gain_over_student: Primary practical-gain gate does not pass while the frozen late_teacher7 reference remains at least 5 successes above student_only; conclude only that a single final score did not demonstrate the frozen gain, with multi-round feedback remaining a hypothesis.
decision_rules.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE; do not infer equivalence or causal mechanism.

secondary_comparison.test: Exact two-sided McNemar test on the same 50 task rows.
secondary_comparison.interpretation: Report paired difference and p-value descriptively against 25536049.pbs101 only; another valid run 25535873.pbs101 was 26/50. Do not call within-five point-estimate similarity statistical equivalence or late7 repeatability.

validity_gates: Reuse exactly the 50 selected baseline task keys in the same order; verify HDF5 episode_idx/step_idx; 50 unique source episodes and no missing/duplicate outcomes.
Validate the current treatment checkpoint path and provenance with the existing strict loader; do not substitute or retrain weights.
Verify seed 42, 300 candidates, 30 CEM rounds, and record pre-solve native generator state and candidate shapes.
At every actual CEM start_batch, validate exactly 30 route calls with teacher only at round 30; all other 29 calls use student cost.
Require all six prepared observation keys and record shape/dtype metadata; verify shared deterministic task rows and preprocessing. No bytewise historical observation claim.
All episode outcomes, route finite flags, output values, and solver timings finite.
Validate the frozen reference file against its source IDs; baseline teacher-only is 49/50 and exactly matches the successful current teacher positive-control vector.
PBS compute guards, successful runner exit, complete artifacts, and 5-second GPU utilization/memory telemetry all pass.
timing_boundary: Record synchronized planner solve and full evaluation wall time for this arm only. Do not make a direct speedup claim against old jobs because arm count/run composition and runtime context differ; no latency gate is set.
failure_rule: Any validity gate failure yields FAIL_CLOSED; preserve artifacts and do not resample, change teacher rounds, or retry under this freeze.

resources.gpu_telemetry: nvidia-smi GPU utilization and memory every 5 seconds to job.log; terminate and wait for monitor PID on exit.
resources.submission: One bounded GPU PBS job after static checks pass.
